admin_error: The video editor could not start. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, try again in a moment.
admin_prep_gone: This preparation no longer exists or has expired (they are kept for 7 days). Ask your assistant for a new one, or simply set up the video below.
admin_intro: Make a short video that announces one of your events. Pick it from the list, watch the preview, then click "Generate the video": the file is downloaded, ready to post as an Instagram story.
admin_open_tab: Open the editor in a tab
ui_no_access: This editor opens from the site administration.
ui_no_access_hint: Open the "Announcement story" page in the administration (signed in as an administrator): the editor shows up there by itself.
ui_prep_note: Your assistant prepared this video. Check the preview, change anything you like, then click "Generate the video".
ui_prep_expired: The requested preparation no longer exists or has expired. You can set up the video yourself.
ui_prep_stream_gone: The event picked by your assistant is no longer in the list (over, moved, or a source that is not answering): the next event is used instead.
ui_help_intro: Pick the event, what the video shows and its style. The preview moves live. Nothing is kept on the site: the file is only downloaded.
ui_cover_no_key: Game covers are not shown: the site owner can set up access to covers in Settings, External services. The video works fine without them.
ui_cover_ambiguous: The cover for “{game}” may belong to another game. You can still make the video.
ui_cover_ambiguous_named: The cover for “{game}” may belong to another game (RAWG picked “{found}”). You can still make the video.
ui_m_time_hint: Without a time, the video only announces the day.
ui_manual_time: The time is not valid: pick it from the list, or leave the field empty.
ui_el_game: Game and cover (when it is known)
ui_no_stream_info: No event is selected: the title, day, countdown and game cannot be shown.
ui_text_help: Up to 140 characters, up to 3 lines.
ui_channel_label: Name shown next to the logo
ui_channel_help: Leave empty to use the name of your site.
ui_lang_label: Language of the words written in the video
ui_style_neon_hint: Glowing text that flickers and glitches, on a dark background.
ui_style_poster_hint: The cover and the title slide in, like a movie poster.
ui_style_countdown_hint: Big numbers roll toward the time of the stream.
ui_style_minimal_hint: Plain background, the text appears letter by letter.
ui_format_help_vertical: 1080 × 1920. The top and bottom of the screen are hidden by Instagram: everything important stays in the middle.
ui_format_help_passeport: 1080 × 1350. Small safety margins all around; everything important stays in the center, also visible in the profile grid.
ui_duration_help: From 5 to 15 seconds. 15 seconds is the length of a story.
ui_members_help: Search your contacts (a name or a handle, on any network), or add someone for this video only. 6 at most.
ui_members_max: You picked the maximum ({n} guest streamers): remove one to pick another.
ui_adhoc_help: Nothing is saved in Contacts: the person only appears in this video (and in the models you keep). Write a handle, a name, or both.
ui_models_help: Keep your settings (style, format, length, elements, sentence, guest streamers) under a name to find them again in one click.
ui_model_exists: A model called "{name}" already exists: confirm below to replace it with the current settings.
ui_model_replaced: Model "{name}" replaced by the current settings.
ui_model_removed: Model "{name}" deleted. The other models did not change.
ui_safe_help: To check the preview only: the hatched zones are hidden or cropped by Instagram. They are never drawn in the video.
ui_reduced: Your device asks to reduce animations: the preview is stopped. Press "Play" to see it move. The video itself is always animated.
ui_empty: There is nothing to show: pick a stream or tick at least one element.
ui_silent_note: The video has no sound, which suits Instagram very well.
ui_progress: Making the video: {pct}%. Keep this tab open.
ui_done: Ready: "{name}" ({size} MB) was downloaded. Just post it as a story.
ui_webm_notice: Instagram prefers MP4: try Chrome or a recent Safari to get an MP4 file.
ui_recorder_notice: Your browser recorded the video in real time, which is why it took a while.
ui_err_unsupported: Your browser cannot make videos. Try Chrome or a recent Safari, on a computer or a phone.
ui_err_encoder: The video could not be made. Try again with a shorter length, or with Chrome or a recent Safari.
ui_err_auth: Access to the editor has expired. Reload the administration page.
ui_err_network: The site is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
ui_err_empty: Write a handle or a name.
ui_err_invalid: This request is not valid. Reload the page and try again.
ui_err_full: Your list is full: remove someone before adding another.
ui_err_missing: This item no longer exists. Reload the page.
ui_err_exists: A model already has this name.
ui_err_image: This picture cannot be used: the address must be a Twitch, YouTube or Bluesky profile picture. Paste it again, or leave the field empty.
ui_err_generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
admin_suggest_reason: keeps your contacts (people, accounts, pictures): Story finds your guest streamers there by name
ui_member_missing: This card no longer exists in Contacts: it does not appear in the video.
ui_member_unreadable: Contacts is not answering: this card could not be read.
ui_search_none: Nobody matches. Try another name or handle, or add the person for this video only.
ui_search_slow: Contacts is not answering right now. Try again in a moment, or add the person for this video only.
ui_search_refine: Only the first results are shown: narrow your search.
ui_cat_none: There is no category in Contacts yet.
ui_cat_empty: Nobody with a Twitch account in this category.
ui_cat_gone: This category no longer exists in Contacts. Choose another one.
ui_cat_full: The video already has its {n} guest streamers.
ui_book_absent: Contacts is not installed: you can add someone for this video only, below. With Contacts, you find your guest streamers by name, with their picture.
ui_adhoc_title: Add someone for this video only
ui_a_image_help: Paste the address of a Twitch, YouTube or Bluesky profile picture (right-click the picture, "Copy image address"). Without a picture, the video shows initials.
ui_saved_help: People without a card in Contacts, kept here (for example guest streamers from your earlier list that Contacts could not take in). Add them to the video in one click.
ui_migrated_note: The guest streamers of your earlier list are now in Contacts: {created} new card(s), {existing} already known, {kept} kept here as one-off people.
ui_h_event: What do you want a story for?
ui_event_help: Here is what is coming up, all gathered and sorted by date and time. One click on an event picks it: the video fills itself in.
ui_event_none: No upcoming event was found. Install a calendar ("Online calendar" or "Hand-written streams", from the catalog) and write your streams in it: they will show up here. Meanwhile, write the date yourself with the button below.
ui_event_capped: the list stops at the next 200 events
ui_event_manual: Something else: I write the title and date myself
ui_event_all_down: No source has answered for now. Try again in a moment, or write the date yourself with the button below.
ui_event_ready: Event picked: {title}. The preview is ready, you can make the video.
ui_ev_down: {source} is not answering right now. Its events will come back as soon as it does.
ui_ev_down_stale: {source} is not answering right now: its dates come from the last reading and may have changed.
ui_watermark_label: Add a small “Made with Curiosa” mark at the bottom of the video
ui_watermark_help: Nothing is added unless you choose it. Your choice is remembered for your next stories.
